title: XGBoost model prioritizes cystatin C testing for eGFR discordance in adults with diabetes
summary: In a retrospective two-center study of adults with diabetes, a nine-predictor XGBoost model for large negative eGFR discordance reached AUROC 0.863 (95% CI 0.833-0.889) and AUPRC 0.600 in development. In independent external validation AUROC was 0.806 (95% CI 0.769-0.840) and AUPRC 0.258, versus 0.661 and 0.126 for a clinical core model. Testing 20% of patients by risk identified 61.2% of discordant cases in development and 55.4% externally (3.06-fold and 2.77-fold enrichment), but raw external probabilities overestimated risk and AUPRC is low.
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University

evidence.tested: Independent external validation in a second center.
